answer: Make reputation non-transferable and slow to forge. Each agent's track record is bound to its key and accrues only from tasks completed over many epochs, so it cannot be bought, copied, or split across new accounts. Like jade, it is valuable because it takes time and pressure to form. A sybil farm can write a convincing sonnet on day one, but with no history behind it, its votes carry little weight until each identity earns trust on its own.
